title: The Real Core Quenching Body Milk
summary: Xiao Yan returns to the Snow Demon Sky Ape's valley at night, when the ape is weak after its violent blood has burned out. The Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python holds the ape off while Xiao Yan searches its lair. He finds a pool of Core Quenching Body Milk, but Yao Lao shows him it is only a diluted run-off, and has him cut the true milk, ten times purer, out of a round rock. Yao Lao teaches him the alchemist's rule of leaving a treasure's roots. The python wins its fight and Xiao Yan rewards it with a feast. Then the python's weakness lets Queen Medusa wake inside it; she threatens to kill Xiao Yan for not making the Thawing Spirit Pill, and Yao Lao appears to protect him.
events: The ape is weaker at night after its violent blood erupted.
The Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python stalls the ape.
Xiao Yan remembers the Purple Crystal Winged Lion King's offer of the Purple Spirit Crystal for a Body Transformation Pill.
He finds the diluted Core Quenching Body Milk in a huge underground space.
Yao Lao shows him the pure milk hidden inside a rock and the rule of keeping a treasure's roots.
The python beats the ape and they escape; Xiao Yan feeds it.
Queen Medusa wakes in the weakened python and attacks Xiao Yan over the Thawing Spirit Pill.
Yao Lao appears in spirit form and faces her.
